title: Unit tests with every change
problem: Changed production behavior can land without meaningful test execution or coverage.
rationale: Code changes require tests and coverage before merge; docs/config use their explicit verification group. Floor and optional delta tolerance are measured then human-selected; branch coverage separately reported where supported.
applicability: Changed executable production paths; non-executable changes require their explicit verification group.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: mapped unit suites ran on the checked tree; changed executable lines measured with Coverage.py or existing JS coverage + **diff-cover**; optional same-config base-to-candidate coverage delta (section 5.2). Missing/empty reports are Error; no executable changed lines = explicit N/A after classification.
target_check.reviewer: assertions exercise behavior and negative paths, not implementation mirrors.
target_check.limits: **D:** mapped unit suites ran on the checked tree; changed executable lines measured with Coverage.py or existing JS coverage + **diff-cover**; optional same-config base-to-candidate coverage delta (section 5.2). target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Code changes require tests and coverage before merge; docs/config use their explicit verification group. repair: Add meaningful behavior and negative-path tests for the changed production path, run its mapped suite, and regenerate exact-tree changed-line coverage. Missing prerequisites remain Unsupported/Error.
